<description>
This is a prerequisite for #31507.

1. We expect that neither the compiler flags nor the test source triggers any warnings, such as `-Wunknown-argument`. Therefore, append `working_compiler_werror_flag`, as done in [`try_append_cxx_flags()`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/cmake/module/TryAppendCXXFlags.cmake).

2. `-msse4` is merely a synonym for `-msse4.2` in both GCC and Clang, but it is not accepted by the clang-cl frontend. Furthermore, the x86 SHA-NI code uses only SSE4.1 intrinsics and no SSE4.2 ones.

Replace `-msse4` with `-msse4.1` to resolve both issues.

The absence of SSE4.2 usage can be verified by building with `-DAPPEND_CXXFLAGS=-mno-sse4.2`.
</description>

index 4abe8febf7..598521a6c2 100644

   )

-  set(X86_SHANI_CXXFLAGS -msse4 -msha)
+  set(X86_SHANI_CXXFLAGS -msse4.1 -msha)
   check_cxx_source_compiles_with_flags("
     #include <immintrin.h>
 
diff --git a/cmake/module/CheckSourceCompilesWithFlags.cmake b/cmake/module/CheckSourceCompilesWithFlags.cmake
index 02bd7265bf..f894e3cf8e 100644
--- a/cmake/module/CheckSourceCompilesWithFlags.cmake
+++ b/cmake/module/CheckSourceCompilesWithFlags.cmake
@@ -3,9 +3,11 @@
 # file COPYING or https://opensource.org/license/mit/.
 
 include_guard(GLOBAL)
+include(CheckCXXSourceCompiles)
+include(TryAppendCXXFlags)
 
 #[=[
-Check once if C++ source code can be compiled.
+Check once if C++ source code can be compiled with no diagnostics.
 
 Options:
 
@@ -25,10 +27,10 @@ The `check_cxx_source_compiles_with_flags()` function handles this case and acce
 #]=]
 function(check_cxx_source_compiles_with_flags source result_var)
   cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 2 _ "" "" "CXXFLAGS;LDFLAGS;LINK_LIBRARIES")
+  list(APPEND __CXXFLAGS ${working_compiler_werror_flag})
   list(JOIN __CXXFLAGS " " CMAKE_REQUIRED_FLAGS)
   set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LINK_OPTIONS ${__LDFLAGS})
   set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES ${__LINK_LIBRARIES})
-  include(CheckCXXSourceCompiles)
   check_cxx_source_compiles("${source}" ${result_var})
   set(${result_var} ${${result_var}} PARENT_SCOPE)
 endfunction()

</patch>
